creative_brief.source: philosophical essay on memory and forgetting
creative_brief.thesis: The image is really about identity as a fragile archive constantly rewritten.
creative_brief.abstract_concept: Classical memory palace eroded and overprinted by present
creative_brief.visual_metaphor: A cracked marble head whose cranium opens into an engraved library interior where pages dissolve into birds and pixels
creative_brief.image_goal: Contemplative philosophical cover image, strange and delightful

art_direction.historical_language: cracked marble bust, engraved library hall, botanical plates, old diagrams
art_direction.contemporary_language: dissolving pixels, data moths, translucent glowing index cards
art_direction.medium: mixed-media editorial collage, scientific illustration plus screen print
art_direction.rendering_language: fine copperplate lines with stippled marble and halftone dissolution
art_direction.composition_language: D central-subject-plus-small-symbols, monumental head center with orbiting fragments
art_direction.color_strategy: dark botanical green dominant bg, cream marble hero, acid lime accent on escaping birds
art_direction.texture_strategy: fine engraving lines, stipple, halftone, paper fiber, ink absorption, misregistration

visual_spec.hero_subject: monumental cracked marble head in profile, cranium opening into a miniature engraved library hall with receding shelves
supporting_elements: pages tearing free and turning into small birds and pixel squares
botanical plates and diagram fragments orbiting the head
tiny ladder and archivist silhouette inside the skull-library
visual_spec.environment: deep botanical-green field with faint constellation grid and drifting paper dust
visual_spec.composition: Pattern D: head center at 70% scale, symmetrical but broken by escaping page-birds top-right, generous dark negative space edges, eye path eye to library to birds
visual_spec.spatial_relationships: foreground head, interior midground library, background green void with orbiting plates
visual_spec.perspective: eye-level profile view, deep apparent focus throughout
visual_spec.lighting: soft directional graphic light, deep ink shadow masses in cracks, paper-white highlights on cheekbone
visual_spec.color_hierarchy: dark green ground, cream-ink hero, acid-lime accent on birds
visual_spec.atmosphere: quiet dusty archive air, slow dissolution
visual_spec.negative_space: dark green margins left and right

non_negotiables: old x new tension (bust-library x pixels)

prompt_strategy.reason: philosophical interior world needs precise spatial nesting

prompts.primary: Scientific-illustration editorial collage with screen-print finish: a monumental cracked marble head in profile rendered in cream and black stippled engraving, its cranium opening into a miniature engraved library hall with receding shelves, a tiny ladder and lone archivist silhouette inside, loose pages tearing free and metamorphosing into small birds and pixel squares that stream top-right, botanical plates and old diagram fragments orbiting the head. Deep botanical-green background with faint constellation grid and drifting paper dust, centered monumental composition at 70 percent scale with generous dark margins, cream-ink hero with single acid-lime accent on the escaping birds, fine copperplate lines, stipple, halftone dissolution, paper fiber and slight misregistration, directional graphic light with ink shadow masses in the cracks and paper-white cheekbone highlights, antique print reproduced through modern screen printing, surreal contemplative literate mood, wordless.
prompts.compact: Cracked marble head opening into tiny library, pages becoming birds and pixels, green engraved collage, cream hero, lime accent.
prompts.model_specific: Scientific illustration collage, monumental marble head with skull-library interior, pages dissolving into birds and pixels, copperplate engraving, botanical green ground, cream hero with lime accent, centered composition, surreal contemplative mood.
